abstract: A 32-year-old woman visited our hospital because of sudden chest pain. A chest computed tomography (CT) revealed an anterior mediastinal tumor with cystic lesions and pleural effusion. Five days after antibiotic therapy, the chest pain and fever did not disappear. A diagnosis of mediastinal mature teratoma was suspected and we resected it by median sternotomy. Cutibacterium acnes infection was identified from both pleural effusion and tumor cyst fluid. She was diagnosed with perforation of the mediastinal tumor and bacterial pleurisy.
abstract_ja: 32歳女性が突然の胸痛で当院を受診した。胸部CTで、嚢胞性病変と胸水を伴う前縦隔腫瘍が認められた。抗菌薬投与の5日後も胸痛と発熱が持続した。縦隔成熟奇形腫が疑われ、胸骨正中切開により切除した。胸水と腫瘍嚢胞液の両方からCutibacterium acnes感染が同定された。腫瘍の穿孔と細菌性胸膜炎と診断された。
